_about: The ad formats of the ad-brief-compiler (section 'Formats'). For each: how many sentences its voice-over has, the sentence (1 = first) on which each on-screen line starts (a line stays up until the next one starts), the ad style code for the sheet, whether sentence 2 plays the before-state, and the edit's rhythm. build_project.py, plan_sheet.py and cut_sheet.py read 'lines' to time the text; a timeline's "format" picks the row, an edit plan's "lines" overrides it.

turn.name: Problem to turn
turn.pace: one or two shots a sentence

story.name: Owner story
story.pace: handheld, one shot a sentence, no punch zoom

list.name: Three reasons
list.pace: a hard cut on every sentence, one shot each

myth.name: Objection, then truth
myth.pace: one or two shots a sentence

after.name: After first
after.pace: open on the finished room, hard cut to the before, Slide Blur back

ritual.name: A day with it
ritual.pace: one slow move a sentence, no punch zoom, no Slide Blur

gift.name: For someone
gift.pace: one or two shots a sentence
